km_text: Vanessa confirms PCI DSS compliance requirements for payment data retention, prompting Maria to introduce the Aegis Comply upsell module
Gregory requests proactive seat-count threshold alerts to avoid discovering overages on future invoices
Julia expresses immediate excitement about Aegis Comply v2 on-demand multi-framework reporting and asks to be included in early access
Keith specifies the need for a true control mapping matrix format showing relationships across SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS, not just concatenated lists
Keith describes the core feature gap: no native cross-framework control mapping report exists in Aegis Comply
Evelyn identifies a feature gap: HIPAA and SOC 2 are treated as completely separate workstreams in the current platform, which is not sustainable for her team

Raymond Burke discovers the retry_on_timeout parameter is undocumented, prompting Dr. Cheng to enumerate a list of support failures including undocumented parameters, delayed response, and lack of proactive notification
Olivia highlights that Aegis Identity's per-app, per-group MFA method enforcement is functionality they could not achieve with Okta, reinforcing product differentiation.
Thomas describes the core pain point: HIPAA reports are static and cannot be filtered by control family, forcing manual work in Excel during audits.
Wayne asks about SOC 2 compliance reporting, signaling potential expansion opportunity with the Aegis Comply add-on module
Nathan confirms PCI DSS is actively on Maplewood's radar due to card transaction volume, expanding the potential scope of the engagement beyond SOC 2.
Raymond highlights the VM backup coverage gap problem — new VMs spun up without agents going unprotected until an incident occurs — and Lisa confirms built-in alerting addresses this
Sarah identifies the misconfigured generic S3 endpoint as a likely contributor to the 403 errors due to cross-region routing
James reveals that on-demand reporting is not yet available but is coming in an upcoming release
Paula requests conditional MFA exclusion model with audit trail for service accounts, citing compliance and operational overhead
Marcus confirms native SCIM 2.0 is not currently in GA, only on the roadmap, without committed timelines
Lauren calls out that a customer had to report the outage before Aegis detected it internally, highlighting a fundamental monitoring gap.
Julia challenges the platform's architecture, pointing out that a single component failure took down the entire monitoring pipeline with no redundancy for an enterprise security product.
Charles identifies persistent issues with high false positive alert noise and cumbersome custom rule configuration as pre-existing concerns beyond the outage
Stephanie acknowledges that alert signal-to-noise concerns were raised with support in January and never satisfactorily resolved, highlighting an ongoing product and support gap.
Harold raises valid product feedback that the UI should show a specific SSL trust error rather than a generic sync failure message
Harold flags that CMMC framework is not covered by the upcoming Comply v2 release, which is a gap given his Q4 audit
Sarah confirms that granular file-level restore is not currently supported in Aegis Protect, validating Jason's suspicion
Dominic asks about a side-by-side comparison view for reports; Kevin confirms it is on the Q3 roadmap but not yet available
Dana requests custom control labeling with internal policy numbers; Elena flags this as a potential feature gap and commits to investigating and logging a formal product request
Isaac reacts positively to Aegis Comply v2's on-demand PCI DSS reporting, noting his compliance team spends six weeks in spreadsheets for audits annually
Gregory requests a native latency alerting feature; David acknowledges it as a product gap and proposes a LogVault-based synthetic monitoring workaround
Rachel acknowledges the lack of in-product pipeline health visibility as a product gap and commits to logging it as a formal feature request
Mina flags API rate limit issues with the Detect integration, revealing a feature gap that has been causing friction in their internal alerting pipeline
Vanessa identifies fragmented dashboards and lack of unified visibility as her biggest pain point during peak seasons
Julia reacts positively to the remediation guidance feature, noting her current process leaves gaps unresolved due to lack of direction — a clear feature gap in their existing tooling.
Derek raises interest in Aegis Comply v2 after seeing the product announcement, opening a potential upsell opportunity
Victor identifies the lack of nested role inheritance as the primary pain point, describing the current flat role model as error-prone and difficult to audit.
Victor raises a second feature gap: the inability to set session timeout policies per role or resource, requiring the most restrictive global policy to apply across all environments.
Warren requests a bespoke custom compliance template feature to track Blackridge-specific internal controls for board reporting
Wayne describes a patchwork IAM environment his IT director has been frustrated with for eight months, signaling an expansion opportunity for Aegis Identity.
